title: French Government Excellence Scholarship
description: Awarded by the French Embassy in Cambodia to outstanding students pursuing engineering or data science studies at ITC. Covers tuition, accommodation, and monthly stipend.
eligibility: Cambodian nationals enrolled in Year 3–5, GPA ≥ 3.5, intermediate French level
application_process: Submit CV, motivation letter, academic transcripts, and French proficiency certificate to the Scholarship Office.

title: ASEAN Development Fund Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship for students in STEM fields across ASEAN member states. Open to ITC students in Data Science and Engineering.
eligibility: ASEAN citizens, GPA ≥ 3.0, enrolled full-time, demonstrated financial need
application_process: Online application via the ASEAN Development Fund portal. ITC Scholarship Office assists with nomination.

title: ITC Internal Merit Scholarship
description: Annual internal scholarship granted by ITC to top-performing students from all departments. Covers 50% of tuition fees for one academic year.
eligibility: Enrolled ITC students, top 5% GPA in department, no pending disciplinary issues
application_process: Automatically nominated by Academic Affairs based on GPA ranking. No application required.
